# S2.9 — The branch model: coherent fork points, inter-run `fork`, `fs_tree` snapshots, `rollback` with compensation list + rewind note, HEAD navigation, `Rewind` frames, GC pinning, `branch_tree` (R-2.2.4⁰ᵃ · R-2.2.1 fork)

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §5a.1 (fork/navigate/rollback) · §5a.4
(`R-2.2.4⁰ᵃ`) · §5a.2 (saga substrate) · §5g.6 (audit/GC/redaction)
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/040_S2.9__branch-model.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.2.4⁰ᵃ · R-2.2.1 (fork)**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s2.8` (stacked) · **Stage:** 2 ·
**Live stage:** offline-only (all checks hermetic)
**ADR:** `docs/adr/ADR-0271-s2.9-branch-model-rulings.md` (D1–D8)

## Summary

The branch model lands end-to-end: the **logical HEAD is now a fold of
the WAL** — `seq`/`prev_hash` stay a dense, linear, append-only chain
while `lifecycle.head.moved` rows move the logical head (D1). `fork`
opens a child run whose `forked_from{run_id, at_seq, head_hash}` anchor
is bound *at the coerced cut* by the store itself and re-verified by
`open_run`'s lineage check (D2); the child's seq-1 audit row is
`lifecycle.run.forked{BranchRecord}` whose envelope `refs` pin every
content address the source prefix references (D7). `env` is
`{snapshot, trace_only, none}` with `shared_live` the typed refusal
(D3); `snapshot` materialises the child workspace **from the snapshot's
blob content** — never the parent's drifted live tree. `rollback` runs
the coherent-cut gate → the scoped saga (`compensate_run_after`,
reverse commit order, `~comp` ids) → the pinned rewind-note blob →
`rolled_back` → `head.moved` + the live `Rewind` frame (D5). Replay-mode
overreach is *recorded* (`effective_replay` + `downgrade_reason`), never
silent (D6). `branch_tree` is a pure rebuildable projection. Nothing is
ever deleted: originals, compensations, escalations and the audit pair
all append.

### `crates/hh-ledger`

- **`branch.rs`** — `BranchRecord`/`RollbackRecord`/`CompensationEntry`/
  `BranchInfo`, `BranchKind`/`EnvBinding`/`ReplayMode`/`ForkOpts`/
  `NavigateTarget`; `Store::fork` (coherence gate + `coerce_to_boundary`,
  `forked_from` fill, the `forked` row + source-prefix pin set);
  `Store::navigate` (`head.moved` row + `Rewind` notify);
  `Store::rollback` (the five-step durable order); `env_snapshots` fold;
  `branch_tree` projection.
- **`store.rs`** — the WAL/logical-head split: `wal_tip_seq`/
  `wal_tip_hash` chain every append; `fold_head` folds `head.moved` in
  both live commit and `rebuild` (replay/live parity); `notify_rewind`
  delivers `EventFrame::Rewind` to subscribers; `head()` is a typed
  error at the root sentinel.
- **`saga.rs`** — `compensate_run_after(run, at_seq, dispatch)`: the
  rollback-scoped walk over applied-after-`at` compensable effects.
- **`classes.rs`** — `lifecycle.run.forked`, `lifecycle.run.rolled_back`,
  `lifecycle.head.moved` registered audit-grade with declared field
  partitions.
- **`errors.rs`** — `SnapshotUnavailable`, `PolicyForbids`,
  `AuthorityWidening`, `CoverageInsufficient`.
- **`views.rs`** — `ViewKind::BranchTree` + `views::branch_tree`
  (derived, rebuildable — never authoritative).

### `crates/hh-env` / `crates/hh-helper`

- **`driver.rs`** — `fs_tree_snapshot` now stamps the real `at_seq`
  (head seq) and persists the record blob (`manifest_ref` on the row);
  `snapshot_for(store, at)` chooses the newest `fs_tree` at/below the
  cut; `derive_from_snapshot` provisions the child workspace from blob
  content (`SnapshotMissing` on a GC'd blob);
  `rollback_env` restores in place and reports `uncaptured` writable
  roots.
- **`snapshot.rs`** — `SnapshotRecord::from_json` (ref re-derived on
  decode); `compute_ref` excludes `at_seq` — provenance, not content
  (D4; keeps AC-R-2.2.4-9 dedup).
- **`fstree.rs`** — `restore_in_place` — removes what the manifest does
  not cover, then replays the manifest with the same recompute check.

### `crates/hh-embed-schema` / `crates/hh-embed`

- **`frames.rs`** — `Frame::Rewind{to_seq, to_event_id, reason}`
  (ephemeral) — the §5a.1 rebase cue.
- **`types.rs`/`ops.rs`/`lib.rs`** — `ForkParams` members (`at` by seq
  or event-ref, `kind`, `env`, `replay_mode`, `policy_ref`,
  `budget_slice_ref`, `coerce_to_boundary`, `snapshot_ref`,
  `manifest_delta` — refused non-empty); `NavigateParams.to` required;
  `CoherentForkPointsParams`; `RollbackParams{to_seq, reason,
  restore_env}`; the four ops flipped to implemented (experimental
  tier); generated artifacts regenerated (CC7).
- **`work.rs`/`service.rs`/`frames.rs`** — `fork` op (inter-run
  event-ref resolution, coverage→replay ladder, snapshot chooser +
  `derive_from_snapshot`, `manifest_delta` refused, read-only child for
  `trace_only`), `navigate`/`coherent_fork_points`/`rollback` ops wired,
  `Rewind` emitted live, `ledger_err` maps the new branch errors.
